# CodeSolid

> > CodeSolid is a comprehensive resource for learning Python, mathematics, and scientific computing through tutorials, guides, and interactive Jupyter notebooks.

CodeSolid provides practical tutorials and documentation covering Python fundamentals, scientific computing with libraries like SymPy and Pandas, mathematical visualization tools, and development environment setup. The site emphasizes hands-on learning through Jupyter notebooks and includes resources for both beginners and intermediate learners.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Jupyter Notebooks
- SymPy
- Pandas
- Docker
- Scientific Computing
- Mathematics Education
- Package Management
- LaTeX
- SageMath
- Desmos
- Pyenv
- Symbolic Math
- Data Visualization
- Getting Started

## Getting Started & Core Navigation

- [CodeSolid Homepage](https://codesolid.com): Main hub for exploring Python, mathematics, and Jupyter notebooks
- [Python for Beginners](https://codesolid.com/category-python-for-beginners-posts): Category index for Python beginner tutorials and fundamentals
- [Python Functions](https://codesolid.com/category-python-functions): Category index for Python function tutorials and best practices
- [Python Practice](https://codesolid.com/category-python-practice): Category index for Python practice exercises and coding projects

## Python Tools & Environment Setup

- [Python Tools](https://codesolid.com/category-python-tools): Category index for Python development tools and environment setup
- [Installing Pyenv on a Mac](https://codesolid.com/installing-pyenv-on-a-mac): Setup guide for Pyenv on Mac with Python version management tips
- [Conda vs. Pip, Venv, and Pyenv](https://codesolid.com/conda-vs-pip): Comparison guide for Python package managers: Conda, Pip, Venv, and Pyenv
- [Docker](https://codesolid.com/category-docker): Category index for Docker containerization and development guides

## Jupyter Notebooks & Interactive Computing

- [Jupyter](https://codesolid.com/category-jupyter): Category index for Jupyter notebooks, Lab, and related tools tutorials
- [Jupyter Password Configuration](https://codesolid.com/jupyter-password): Configuration guide for Jupyter password setup and authentication
- [Using Desmos Graphs in Jupyter Notebooks](https://codesolid.com/math/desmos-jupyter): Tutorial for integrating Desmos interactive graphs in Jupyter notebooks
- [Yet Another JDesmos Demo](https://codesolid.com/math/yet-another-jdesmos-demo): JDesmos demo and API documentation for Desmos graphing in Jupyter

## Scientific Computing & Mathematics

- [Python Math and Science](https://codesolid.com/category-python-math-and-science): Category index for Python scientific computing and mathematics tutorials
- [Math and Math Software](https://codesolid.com/category-math-and-math-software): Category index for math and mathematical software tutorials and guides
- [Using LaTeX In Python](https://codesolid.com/using-latex-in-python): Guide to using LaTeX with Python, Jupyter, and SymPy for math expressions
- [The Inner Product of Complex Vectors](https://codesolid.com/complex-inner-products): Tutorial on complex vector inner products with Python and quantum mechanics
- [Multivariable Calculus Sage Notebooks](https://codesolid.com/sage/calc3): SageMath notebooks for multivariable calculus study and MOOC course

## Data Analysis & Pandas

- [Pandas](https://codesolid.com/category-pandas): Category index for Pandas data analysis and manipulation tutorials
